query:
SELECT id, "trainingName", status, "currentProgress", iterations, "trainingPhase", "isLegacy", "errorMessage", "createdAt", "updatedAt" 
FROM "trainingSessions" 
WHERE status = 'in_progress' 
ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC 
LIMIT 10;
